mentions.h: 50 GLORIOUS YEARS ON THE BRIGHTON ROAD

mentions.note: began race walking at 44 with North London Harriers; first to finish three successive Brighton and Back races
first to complete three successive London to Brighton and Back walks (1921 24h:23m.42s, 1926 22h:28m.04s, 1929 21h:35m.07s); began walking aged 44 in 1919; died about 1932
